subject: In the midst of studying my Japanese, Sec+, and working on my site, I decided to go check out the local stores! Though I'm introverted, I spent the majority of my years in college being a cave dweller and didn't go to as many places as I would've loved to, due to being nervous or not having the energy too? Not anymore though! Checked out this place called Inno Coffee down in Nago, Okinawa, and the owner I assume, was making drip coffee per customer and it was de-li-cious! I ordered the latte with the brown sugar syrup he had, and made the mistake of not mixing it, but I dunno. Something about that coffee and the way it goes with the milk was just divine! Also there was a biscoff(?), biscuit that paired well with it! Right next to the coffee store was a small bakery where I bought a crumble fruit cake..? Forgot the name, didn't forget the taste. M-a-n, it was good, it's overall really soft and the inside was creamy. The top had small berries which packed a punch and as the name would suggest, there were these crunchy crumbled parts which just added to the experience. Afterwards just shopped at nearby stores, and went on back (didn't buy much but browsed). It was a joy! Going to check out the ruins they got nearby, and some other locations. Maybe even walk to the dam?
